title: Soul Feast #23: The New Male and The New Female
excerpt: In this Soul Feast, Gary introduces two powerful new archetypes emerging with the new consciousness—the new male and the new female.
bodyHtml:
In this Soul Feast, Gary introduces two powerful new archetypes emerging with the new consciousness—the new male and the new female. He explains how these roles replace the old, five-sensory definitions of masculinity and femininity, which were based on external power, control, and survival. 

The new male and the new female are no longer confined by traditional societal roles but instead embrace emotional awareness, intuition, and spiritual partnership.

The old male was defined by his ability to protect and provide, while the old female found fulfillment in bearing and raising children. These roles fit neatly within the five-sensory pursuit of external power, but they no longer serve us in the new multi-sensory consciousness. 

The new male is emotionally aware, intuitive, and deeply engaged in relationships, while the new female is unrestricted by old limitations and free to pursue meaning in all areas of life.

Together, they seek spiritual partnership—a relationship built on equality and mutual spiritual growth.

The key to embracing these new archetypes is choosing roles based on meaning rather than societal expectations. Whether a male chooses to be a stay-at-home father or a female chooses to lead a multinational corporation, the focus is on fulfillment, contribution, and creating authentic power.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (00:41): What an archetype is and how it shapes human experience.
  • (03:07): How the old male and the old female were defined by external power and societal roles.
  • (06:45): The new male and the new female—freedom from traditional gender expectations.
  • (08:41): How the new consciousness allows for fluidity in roles and relationships.
  • (11:13): Why spiritual partnership is the foundational dynamics between the new male and the new female.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: Take a moment to reflect on how you see yourself in the roles of male or female. Are your choices shaped by societal expectations or by what brings you true meaning and fulfillment? Write down how you might redefine your role based on love rather than fear, and explore ways to express the qualities of the new male or the new female in your life.
